channel.title: Jumoo Releases
channel.description: Latest NuGet package releases from Jumoo

item.title: uSync CLI 17.2.0
item.description:
## New * `files-verify` checks a uSync folder before you import it: invalid XML, merge conflict markers, duplicate keys, alias clashes, broken references and unknown files. * `usync-report` reports what an import would change without running it. On GitHub Actions it also writes a step summary. * `usync-ping --timeout` waits for a site to come up. * The server and credentials can now come from environment variables, so they don't have to be on the command line.
## Changed * `healthcheck-group-check` now exits with 1 when the results contain errors. A pipeline step that ran it will now fail on those errors. * `usync-ping` fails straight away when the site rejects the credentials, instead of retrying until the timeout. * Errors print as one line rather than a stack trace. Set `USYNC_DEBUG` to get the full trace. * The tool rolls forward to newer .NET runtimes.
## What's Changed * Build on demand, scan CodeQL weekly, update Dependabot monthly by @KevinJump in https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.CommandLine/pull/25 * Pipeline commands: files-verify, usync-report, env-var credentials, clean errors by @KevinJump in https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.CommandLine/pull/26
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.CommandLine/compare/v17.1.1...v17.2.0

item.title: Google Connector 18.0.2
item.description:
### Fixed
- The Map glossaries setting is returned with the connector's options as `mapGlossaries`, the key the settings screen and the connector use, so the toggle shows its saved value instead of always showing off. Settings saved under the old `useGlossaries` key are still read (also in 17.1.2).
### Changed
- Backoffice client dependency updates (Vite, Prettier).

item.title: DeepL Connector 18.2.2
item.description:
### Fixed
- Map glossaries and the advanced settings (model type, tag handling version, outline detection, preserve formatting, ignore, splitting and non-splitting tags) now load on the config page. They were saved but never returned, so the page showed defaults and the next save removed them (also in 17.4.2). - Ignore tags and non-splitting tags were swapped when building the DeepL request. - Upgrading from v13: a stored `mapGlossary` value is honoured when `mapGlossaries` isn't set.
### Changed
- Backoffice client dependency updates (Vite, Prettier).

item.title: Jumoo.Processing 18.4.1
item.description:
Includes the changes in 17.6.1, merged forward from `v17/main`.
### Changed
- The queue no longer writes a copy of the whole pipeline onto the queue row when a run starts, resumes or moves to the background. The queue only ever read that copy if the pipeline's own row had gone, and it couldn't read it back even then, so nothing used it. A run whose pipeline is cleared or deleted while it waits on the queue stops with "Pipeline not found", as it did before. The `Data` column stays, and is ignored on rows queued before the upgrade.

item.title: Jumoo.Json 19.0.0-rc2
item.description:
### Changed
- `TryConvertToJsonNode(object)` and `TryParseToJsonNode(object)` no longer turn a `JsonObject`, `JsonArray` or object/array `JsonElement` into an indented string just to parse it back. They write compact UTF-8 into a pooled buffer, or read the element's raw bytes, and parse that. On a large payload this cuts allocations by more than half (829 KB to 313 KB for a node). The result is unchanged: a fresh, parentless node with the library's node options. - Test and build dependency updates.

item.description:

### Added
- Helpers used by uSync: `ConvertToJsonNode(string)` / `ConvertToJsonNode(object)`, a non-generic `TryGetValueAs(object?, Type, out object?)`, `AddOrRemoveIfNull<TNode>`, `IsNonStringJsonValue` and a `GetPropertyAsBool(..., bool defaultValue)` overload. - UTF-8 span and `Stream` overloads on `JsonSerialization`: `TryDeserialize`, `DeserializeJsonAsync`, `TrySerializeToStream`, `TrySerializeToStreamAsync`. - XML documentation now ships in the package.
### Changed

item.title: uSync Commerce 18.0.2
item.description:
### Fixed
- Shipping method prices were never synced: the export didn't write them, a price change didn't change the file, and an import created the method with no prices. Prices are now exported and imported, including dynamic and real-time calculation configs. A file exported before this fix leaves the existing prices alone, and a file whose calculation mode differs from the method's is skipped with a warning, because Umbraco Commerce only sets the mode when the method is created. Every shipping method file changes on its first export after upgrading ([#23](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/issues/23)). - Nothing was exported on save when the site called `AddUmbracoCommerce` itself in `Program.cs` (as SQLite needs, for `AddSQLite()`). `AddUmbracoCommerce` only runs its setup callback on the first call, so the package's save and delete handlers were dropped. They are now registered against the existing Commerce builder, whichever order the calls run in ([#25](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/pull/25)). - An item deleted in Umbraco Commerce couldn't be added back by importing its file: the import reported no change and the item stayed hidden. Umbraco Commerce keeps deleted items in the database, and uSync treated them as still there. Deleted items are now ignored, and the import creates the item again. Because the deleted item keeps its key, the new one gets a new key and is matched by alias from then on. A deleted store can't be recreated this way, because other items find their store by key, so its import fails with a message saying why ([#24](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/issues/24)).

A file exported before this fix leaves the existing prices alone, and a file whose calculation mode differs from the method's is skipped with a warning, because Umbraco Commerce only sets the mode when the method is created. Every shipping method file changes on its first export after upgrading ([#23](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/issues/23)). - Nothing was exported on save when the site called `AddUmbracoCommerce` itself in `Program.cs` (as SQLite needs, for `AddSQLite()`). `AddUmbracoCommerce` only runs its setup callback on the first call, so the package's save and delete handlers were dropped. They are now registered against the existing Commerce builder, whichever order the calls run in ([#25](https://github.com/Jumoo/uSync.Umbraco.Commerce/pull/25)). - An item deleted in Umbraco Commerce couldn't be added back by importing its file: the import reported no change and the item stayed hidden. Publishing an element now records its version per culture, the same way publishing a document does, so an element translated before a later change shows as out of date - Add: when Umbraco.AI is set up on the site and the Umbraco.AI connector (`Jumoo.TranslationManager.UmbracoAi`) isn't installed, the Connectors page has a banner across the top, and the bottom of the AI connector's settings page has a small "Using Umbraco.AI?" button. Translation Manager checks for Umbraco.AI by type name and has no reference to it (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#178) - Docs: the README and NuGet description name the Umbraco.AI connector, for sites that want to translate through their Umbraco.AI setup. The bundled AI connector is still the one most sites should use (Jumoo/Jumoo.TranslationManager#178)

item.title: AI Connector 17.8.0
item.description:

Errors and batch state are one-line notices, and the prompt opens in a side panel. - The connector settings screen is split into a provider box and a Translation box, with advanced settings behind a cog. API keys and secrets are password inputs, and a saved model the provider no longer lists stays visible instead of switching to the first option. - New default models: `gpt-6-luna` for OpenAI, `gemini-3.6-flash` for Gemini, `claude-sonnet-5-5` for Claude and `gpt-5.4-mini` for GitHub Models and Azure. - Long runs with large results put much less load on the database. A pipeline's results are now stored compressed in their own column, and are only written again when a step changes them. The save after each step no longer reads the whole stored pipeline back first. On large uSync publisher pushes this cut the rows written by about 90%, which makes write lock timeouts and running out of memory much less likely. - The backoffice no longer downloads a pipeline's results after every step while it is running. It gets them when the run stops, finishes, fails or waits for you. - Closing a run's dialog clears it with a single delete instead of reading the whole run first. - Background runs no longer write a full copy of the pipeline into the queue after every step.
### Upgrading
- A database migration adds the new columns to `Jumoo_Pipelines` when the site starts. Runs that are in progress during the upgrade carry on, including any cancel already asked for. Finished runs are left as they are and still read back with their results. - `ProcessPipeline` takes a new optional `omitRunningResults` query parameter. Callers that don't send it get the whole pipeline, as before. - If a background run's pipeline is deleted between steps, the run now stops with "Pipeline not found" rather than being re-created from the previous step.

item.title: uSync Complete 18.4.1
item.description:
# v18.4.1
Brings the v17.7.1 work forward to Umbraco 18. 18.4.1 makes large Publisher pushes and pulls lighter, and fixes pulls to a server that requires approval when "Delete missing" is on. Upgrading is recommended if you push or pull a lot of content at once, or use approvals.
## Changed
- Publisher keeps long changed values (block lists, rich text and so on) shortened while a push or pull is running, so large pushes stay quick and use less memory. The change details dialog fetches the full values when you open an item, including for approvers reviewing a request. ([KevinJump/uSync#1215](https://github.com/KevinJump/uSync/issues/1215)) - Once a push or pull has finished, values that were shortened are listed as they are, under "Shortened values", rather than compared. - For developers: code that handles `uSyncPublisherActionCompletedNotification` may now find long values in the `Details` of its `Actions` shortened. The same goes for the reports an approval keeps once its run has finished.
## Fixed
- Publisher: a pull from a server that requires approval now applies when "Delete missing" is on, instead of failing with "Missing File". - Publisher: an approval whose run fails no longer shows its changes as made.
## Updated
- Jumoo.Processing 18.3.4.
## Requirements
- Umbraco 18. - uSync 18.3.1 or later. - Jumoo.Processing 18.3.4 (installed automatically).
